title: Reset your VPN password
content: Open the company password portal, select 'Reset password', and complete multi-factor authentication. Wait up to five minutes, then sign in to the VPN using your new password. If the reset fails, contact IT Support.

title: Troubleshoot a slow laptop
content: Save your work and restart the laptop first. Disconnect unused USB devices and close applications you do not need. If the problem continues after a restart, create a support ticket with the affected application and when the slowdown began.

title: Connect to the office Wi-Fi
content: Choose the 'Company-WiFi' network, then sign in with your employee email address and current password. Forget any older saved Company-WiFi network before trying again.
